name: DarkQuest

intervals.label: proposed (Snowmass 2021 contribution)
intervals.note: This is the date of the Snowmass planning-document proposal, not a formal experiment-approval date; no source fetched this session states that DarkQuest has been formally approved or scheduled.

physics_goals.value: Search for visible decays of dark-sector particles (e.g. dark photons, axion-like particles, dark scalars) with leading sensitivity, reusing existing Fermilab accelerator and detector infrastructure
physics_goals.quote: DarkQuest is a proton fixed-target experiment with leading sensitivity to an array of visible dark sector signatures

unique_capabilities.value: A proposed dark-sector upgrade/run mode of the existing SeaQuest/SpinQuest spectrometer, offering 'powerful but modest-cost' new physics reach on a short timescale by reusing installed accelerator and detector infrastructure rather than building a new facility
unique_capabilities.quote: builds off of existing accelerator and detector infrastructure

summary.plain: DarkQuest is a proposed Fermilab experiment that would reuse the SeaQuest particle detector to search for hidden, dark-sector particles instead of ordinary quarks, at low cost since it builds on equipment already installed.
summary.technical: Proposed dark-sector upgrade (Snowmass 2021 contribution, arXiv:2203.08322) to the SeaQuest/SpinQuest spectrometer at the 120 GeV Fermilab Main Injector, targeting visible decays of dark photons, axion-like particles and dark scalars in the MeV-GeV mass range; not yet formally approved as of the sources fetched this session.

notes: Derived fields (detector_ids, site_ids, result_ids, document_ids) are deliberately not written (v0.2 A1).

collaboration_ids left empty: no source fetched this session names a distinct 'DarkQuest Collaboration' separate from the SeaQuest/SpinQuest proponents; no collaboration:darkquest record was created rather than inventing one.

The proposal paper positions DarkQuest as an upgrade to 'SpinQuest' (Fermilab E-1039, the spin-physics successor to SeaQuest that reuses the same spectrometer), not directly to SeaQuest; the `upgrade_of` lineage row points to experiment:seaquest (the id this workstream owns per the coverage file) since SpinQuest is out of this wave's scope and has no record here. This is noted as a simplification.

No detector record created: DarkQuest is described as reusing the SeaQuest/SpinQuest apparatus at site:fermilab-nm4-hall (see experiment:seaquest and detector:seaquest) rather than a distinct new detector; no source fetched this session describes DarkQuest-specific hardware changes in enough detail to justify a separate detector file in this pass.
status is `proposed` because the only source found is a 2021/2022 Snowmass community-planning contribution, not an approval document; do not read this as an active or under-construction programme.
